description: Inventory recent committed and uncommitted changes, review independent slices concurrently with bounded read-only fanout, reduce findings, and delegate blocking fixes until no high or mid findings remain.

prompts.rielaPromptTemplate: Coordinate {{workflowId}}. Step 1 inventories the exact recent committed and uncommitted change set and emits complete stable reviewSlices. Riela reviews those slices concurrently as read-only fanout branches. Step 2 reduces every branch result and routes to Step 3 when any high or mid finding remains; otherwise finish. Step 3 delegates the merged blocking findings to codex-design-and-implement-review-loop. After completion, Step 4 routes back to a fresh inventory and fanout pass.
prompts.workerSystemPromptTemplate: Return concise business JSON only. Keep severity, reviewed commands, delegated-workflow inputs, changed files, verification, and routing decisions explicit.

steps.description: Inventory recent changes and partition the exact review scope into independent read-only slices.
Review one complete change slice independently without modifying the workspace.
Reduce all fanout branch results and exit only when none contains a high or mid finding.
Package blocking findings into a delegated issue-resolution request for codex-design-and-implement-review-loop.
Consume the delegated workflow result and prepare the next recent-change review pass.
Publish the accepted review summary once no high or mid findings remain.

rielaPackage.title: codex-recent-change-quality-loop
rielaPackage.description: Review recent changes through bounded read-only slice fanout, deterministic reduction, and delegated blocking fixes.
